Incoterms 2020

Calcolo del Fissaggio

The technical assessment of the type, quantity, and placement of securing materials (lashings) needed to stabilize cargo inside a container or on a vessel, ensuring compliance with safety standards.

Quick answer: The technical assessment of the type, quantity, and placement of securing materials (lashings) needed to stabilize cargo inside a container or on a vessel, ensuring compliance with safety standards.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Calcolo del Fissaggio?

In this glossary, Calcolo del Fissaggio refers to: The technical assessment of the type, quantity, and placement of securing materials (lashings) needed to stabilize cargo inside a container or on a vessel, ensuring compliance with safety standards.

How is Calcolo del Fissaggio used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Il calcolo del fissaggio ha garantito che tutti i macchinari pesanti fossero fissati secondo i regolamenti IMO per il trasporto marittimo."

Why does Calcolo del Fissaggio matter in logistics?

Calcolo del Fissaggio matters because it supports clear communication in Incoterms 2020 contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Definition

The technical assessment of the type, quantity, and placement of securing materials (lashings) needed to stabilize cargo inside a container or on a vessel, ensuring compliance with safety standards.
